src:
cat > my.cron <<'EOF'
# m  h  dom mon dow  command
15  1  *   *   *    /home/student/cdac/pull_marks.sh >> /home/student/cdac/logs/pull.log 2>&1
*/15 8-18 * *  1-5  /home/student/cdac/check_lms.sh
0   3  *   *   0    find /home/student/cdac/logs -name '*.log' -mtime +30 -delete
EOF
crontab my.cron
crontab -l
crontab -r; crontab -l
